title: Match Field
summary: Shows which character a confirmation stops matching at, without revealing either value, so a mistyped password or account number is caught.
description: Enter-twice field for passwords and account numbers that shows the position where the confirmation stops matching without revealing either value, and refuses a paste into the confirm box only when it is a copy of the first entry, so password managers keep working.
catches: Confirmation that differs from the first entry, with the mismatch position
Paste into the confirm box copied from the first box
limits: Only compares the two entries; it can't know the first one is what the user meant
Doesn't validate password strength or account-number checksums
a11y: Both inputs have visible labels; the confirm box has aria-invalid on mismatch and is described by the status
Match status and paste notices are polite live regions
The position marker is aria-hidden; the status text says where it differs
server: Validate the account number or password again on the server; the match check is client-side only.
stops: Mistyped confirm password or account number
